Portfolio news brief — 29 August 2026

Market and major-name developments
- Sign up for free online courses covering the most important core topics in the crypto universe and earn your on-chain certificate - demonstrating your new knowledge of major Web3 topics. (Decrypt)
- Chevron ( CVX +1.05% ) posted stellar second-quarter results at the end of July, beating the street's estimates thanks to higher oil prices, increased production volumes, and strong margins. However, even bigger news is that Chevron has entered into a 20-year power purchase agreement (PPA) to build a natural gas-powered facility to power Microsoft 's ( MSFT +1.68% ) artificial intelligence (AI)-focused data center in Texas. (The Motley Fool)
- Nvidia 's ( NVDA -4.58% ) fiscal 2027 second-quarter earnings report was less of a quarterly update than it was a reminder that the company sits at the center of the artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure build-out. Total revenue reached $96.2 billion, more than double the $46.7 billion posted a year ago and up 18% from the prior quarter. (The Motley Fool)

Meta (META)
- Meta Platforms ( META +1.21% ) is once again releasing some of its artificial intelligence (AI) models with open weights, allowing developers to download and modify them. The company released Muse Glimmer, a 30-billion-parameter model, on Aug. (The Motley Fool)

NVIDIA (NVDA; VOO top-five holding)
- Nvidia ( NVDA -4.58% ) just told the market that it is willing to lock down more than a quarter-trillion dollars' worth of critical components to scale its data center empire. During second-quarter earnings, Nvidia CFO Colette Kress revealed that the company will be spending $279 billion on supply commitments over the next few years -- up from $119 billion only three months earlier. (The Motley Fool)

Bitcoin (BTC)
- It's possible, and even probable, that the climbing national debt of the U.S. will be a tailwind for Bitcoin ( BTC +0.91% ) over the long run. (The Motley Fool)
- Last week, crypto exchange operator Kraken announced the Krak Card, a debit instrument that provides cashback in either traditional U.S. This isn't the first crypto cashback plastic on the scene and, given the recent upswing in digital coinage, probably not the last. (The Motley Fool)

Ethereum (ETH)
- Bitmine Immersion Technologies ( BMNR -7.14% ) is a digital asset treasury (DAT) company led by chairman Tom Lee, and it's been buying Ethereum ( ETH +1.01% ) weekly for 14 months. 17 alone, it bought 9,926 ETH worth around $19 million, only to buy another 32,447 ETH just six days later. (The Motley Fool)

Apple (AAPL; VOO top-five holding)
- CNBC's MacKenzie Sigalos reports on the division of labor taking shape at Apple, with Tim Cook shifting toward diplomacy and policy as John Ternus takes control of the product roadmap. (CNBC)
- CNBC's MacKenzie Sigalos reports on Tim Cook's final moves as Apple CEO — taking on layoffs, price hikes, and smaller product updates before John Ternus takes over. (CNBC)

Informational only — verify primary sources before making investment decisions.
Routine price moves and stock-picking speculation are intentionally excluded.
